feedback_request.integration_feedback: Report line_loss_events per track against the one loss each on s-bend and slalom in iteration 6. Report progress on s-bend and slalom against 0.157 and 0.100. Report max_error on oval, s-bend and slalom against 0.0612, 0.0637 and 0.0612. Say whether slalom steering_oscillation stayed below about 0.15 (it was 0.133). Say whether the outer sensors at ±0.055 saturate or add any lag on the curves. If the oval floor stays at about 0.061, say so explicitly.

intent: Test whether widening the outer sensors from ±0.05 to ±0.055 at the forward row y=0.06 removes the line losses that appeared on s-bend and slalom in iteration 6, while keeping the progress gain from earlier sensing. Only the span changes from iteration 6. Expected: line_loss_events at 0 on all tracks, s-bend and slalom progress at or above their iteration 6 values, and steering_oscillation below about 0.15 on slalom.
learning: Pending this race. If line_loss_events fall to 0 and progress holds, keep y=0.06 and ±0.055, then test whether the oval floor moves with a smaller footprint (0.012 m) at this row. If line losses persist at ±0.055, the loss comes from the curve geometry at y=0.06 rather than span, so move the row back to y=0.045 as the intermediate step the Integrator suggested.
rationale: Iteration 6 (outer sensors at y=0.06, span ±0.05, 16 mm, 0.12 m track, 0.035 m radius, 0.6 kg) is the best result so far at 51.67, up from 26.99. The gain came from progress, not from the floor: s-bend progress rose from 0.040 to 0.157 and slalom from 0.035 to 0.100. Oval was unchanged (progress 0.115, max_error 0.0612), and max_error rose slightly on s-bend (0.0628 to 0.0637). Forward sensing is therefore the first lever that has moved progress on the bends. The price is that line losses returned: s-bend and slalom each logged one loss, while iteration 5 at y=0.03 had none. Slalom steering_oscillation rose to 0.133, below the 0.15 threshold the Integrator set. The Integrator's rule for this case is to keep y=0.06 and widen the span toward ±0.055 if line losses appear. Iteration 2 showed that a ±0.06 span removed losses at y=0.03, and iteration 4 showed ±0.05 did too at that row, so the loss at y=0.06 points to the outer sensors losing the tape on a curve before the robot can recover. I change one thing: the outer sensors go from ±0.05 to ±0.055 at y=0.06, keeping 16 mm footprints and the 0.0275 m spacing, which still covers the 25 mm tape with no gaps. Everything else is held fixed so the change isolates span at the forward row. I expect line_loss_events to fall to 0 on s-bend and slalom, slalom progress to stay near or above 0.10, and the score to rise as loss penalties go. The oval floor at about 0.061 is likely unchanged, and I do not expect a finish yet.
